name: SIFO-Multiturn
description: SIFO-Multiturn evaluates instruction following capabilities in multi-turn conversational settings, testing how well models maintain context and follow instructions across multiple exchanges.
reputation: Specialized benchmark for multi-turn instruction following; tests constraint satisfaction across dialogue turns; used in Chinese LLM evaluation contexts
notes: Evaluates models on maintaining and satisfying instructions given across multiple dialogue turns. Tests whether models correctly remember and apply constraints set in prior turns. Related to IFEval-style evaluation but in multi-turn settings.
